# C1 synthetic discussion drafts

These two recordings read the original fictional discussions in `content/c1-listening.json`. They are synthetic speech, not human conversations or a reviewed C1 assessment. The site serves pre-generated MP3 files; no speech model runs for the learner.

Generation: `kokoro` 0.9.4, [hexgrad/Kokoro-82M](https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M) revision `f3ff3571791e39611d31c381e3a41a3af07b4987`, voices `af_heart` and `am_michael`. The model repository labels its model and voice weights Apache-2.0. The project's original text and generated-output release terms remain pending maintainer confirmation. Sentences were generated at 24 kHz, separated by 0.25-second pauses and 0.55-second speaker pauses, then assembled WAV files were transcoded to MP3 with FFmpeg qscale 4. Transcripts, sentence-aligned evidence intervals, durations and SHA-256 values are in `content/c1-listening.json` and `content/audio-sources.json`.

Independent pronunciation/transcript, teaching and answer review, plus real-phone playback, remain pending.
